newsitem.title: DENMARK: EU monetary committee meets in Copenhagen.
newsitem.headline: EU monetary committee meets in Copenhagen.

text.p: The European Union's monetary committee began an informal meeting in the Danish capital on Friday, local central bank and economy ministry officials told Reuters.

The officials would not say what was on the agenda but said the meeting was routine and attended by senior officials of member states' central banks and finance ministries. They said that there would be no public statement following the talks.

The committee, which works on the detail of European monetary decisions, normally meets in Brussels but can meet informally and in private elsewhere. A preparatory meeting could be held ahead of next month's Amsterdam EU summit.

The June heads of state meeting is expected to be overshadowed by clouds over the timing and shape of economic and monetary union caused by the French election and Germany's controversial plan to revalue gold assets. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
